# Module `lune_ui_core::widgets::sidebar`

[API reference](../../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core::widgets`](../widgets.md)

The sidebar (`layout.sidebar`, D149): a column on the window glass holding navigation rows or
wizard steps, and a status footer pinned to its bottom.

[`Ui::sidebar`](../ui.md#method.Ui.sidebar) draws no card and no fill: it sits on the layer the app drew. The caller's rect
sets the column (its width should be [`WIDTH`](sidebar.md#constant.WIDTH), 208, and its height is where the footer lands:
the footer's bottom is [`MARGIN_BOTTOM`](sidebar.md#constant.MARGIN_BOTTOM) above the rect's bottom). The body is either
[`Ui::nav_list`](../ui.md#method.Ui.nav_list) (one roving stop; keys as `widget.nav-item`) or [`Ui::steps`](../ui.md#method.Ui.steps) (not interactive),
inset [`NAV_PAD`](sidebar.md#constant.NAV_PAD). The footer is static text with a status dot over a hairline and takes no
input.

The nodes: a `Group` named `name` over the nav list, or the steps' own `Navigation` named
`name`, then the footer as a polite `Status` after them.
